shots.scene: 欣欣站在一个白色箱式转移室旁，箱里有几只小培养瓶，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a white box-shaped transfer chamber with two round arm ports and a few small culture jars inside, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲植物组织培养的无菌技术。
overlay: 植物组织培养的无菌技术

shots.scene: 洗手、喷壶、培养皿、警示三角四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: washing hands, a blank spray bottle, a petri dish with a green plantlet, and a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 防污染，也要防伤人。

shots.scene: 阿杰披着长发、袖子挽起，一边说笑一边把手伸进转移室
shots.prompt_en: The young male student with loose long hair and rolled-up sleeves chats and laughs while reaching both arms into a transfer chamber.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次做组培，边聊边操作。

shots.scene: 一周后，阿杰的培养皿里长满白色绒毛，他凑近想打开
shots.prompt_en: A week later, the young male student holds a petri dish covered with white fuzzy growth and reaches to lift the lid.
shots.narration: 一周后培养皿长了毛，他想打开看看。

shots.scene: 小研按住培养皿盖子，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student presses the lid of the petri dish down with a gloved hand and shakes her head.
shots.narration: 小研按住盖子：先别开，先报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 无菌技术，要从头学起。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着空白笔记本和笔，旁边是暂停、回放图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank notebook and a pen, next to pause and replay icons.
shots.narration: 这是一节复习课，边看边记要点。

shots.scene: 阿杰在课桌前按下暂停图标，低头记笔记
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits at a desk, taps a pause icon on a blank tablet, and writes in a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 没看懂就暂停，回头再看一遍。

shots.section_title: 为组培实验复习无菌技术
shots.scene: 试管里的蕨类小苗和一片蕨叶图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small fern plantlet growing on gel in a culture tube next to a fern leaf. No people.
shots.narration: 这次实验，是用组织培养繁殖蕨类。
overlay: 为组培实验复习无菌技术

shots.section_title: 为组培实验复习无菌技术
shots.scene: 王老师在讲台前介绍实验，身后是空白屏幕
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator introduces the lab activity to a class in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 动手之前，先把无菌技术复习一遍。

shots.scene: 白色箱式转移室，前面两个圆形手孔
shots.prompt_en: A white box-shaped transfer chamber with two round arm ports on the front, a blank spray bottle and small jars inside. No people.
shots.narration: 转接操作，在转移室或工作台里做。

shots.scene: 转移室外的灰尘颗粒被挡在箱外，箱内培养皿干净
shots.prompt_en: An icon of dust particles blocked outside a clear box while a clean petri dish sits inside. No people.
shots.narration: 目的就是不让杂菌落进培养皿。

shots.section_title: 培养基也是细菌的美餐
shots.scene: 装着淡黄色琼脂的培养皿，上面一棵绿色小苗
shots.prompt_en: A petri dish with pale yellow agar and a small green plantlet on it. No people.
shots.narration: 培养基营养丰富，小苗长得好，
overlay: 培养基也是细菌的美餐

shots.section_title: 培养基也是细菌的美餐
shots.scene: 同一个培养皿里冒出细菌和霉菌图标
shots.prompt_en: The same petri dish with cartoon bacteria and mold icons popping up around the plantlet. No people.
shots.narration: 细菌和真菌也一样长得好。

shots.section_title: 培养基也是细菌的美餐
shots.scene: 长满细菌菌落的琼脂平板
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of an agar plate covered with cream-colored bacterial colonies. No people.
shots.narration: 这就是被细菌污染的培养皿。

shots.scene: 细菌图标啃食嫩绿的植物组织
shots.prompt_en: Cartoon bacteria icons nibbling on tender green plant tissue. No people.
shots.narration: 杂菌会吃掉幼嫩的植物细胞，

shots.scene: 左边发黄枯萎的组培物，右边健康的绿色组培物
shots.prompt_en: Two culture jars side by side: on the left a browned, wilted plant culture, on the right a healthy green one. No people.
shots.narration: 最后整个培养物都会死掉。

shots.section_title: 有的菌对人有害，污染皿不开
shots.scene: 培养皿里的细菌图标旁出现人形和警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A petri dish with bacteria icons next to a person silhouette and a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 有的杂菌还可能对人有害。
overlay: 有的菌对人有害，污染皿不开

shots.section_title: 有的菌对人有害，污染皿不开
shots.scene: 细菌图标在培养皿中迅速成倍增多
shots.prompt_en: An icon sequence of bacteria in a petri dish doubling quickly, with a rising arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 它们在培养基里繁殖得很快。

shots.section_title: 有的菌对人有害，污染皿不开
shots.scene: 被打开的污染培养皿图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a contaminated petri dish with its lid lifted, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 所以，污染的培养皿绝不能打开。

shots.scene: 看似干净的实验台，放大镜下满是孢子和细菌
shots.prompt_en: A clean-looking lab bench; a magnifying glass reveals many spores and bacteria on its surface. No people.
shots.narration: 台面看着干净，其实到处是微生物。

shots.scene: 空气、手、台面、植物叶片四个图标上都有小孢子
shots.prompt_en: Four icons each dotted with tiny spores: air, a hand, a bench top and a plant leaf. No people.
shots.narration: 空气里、身上，连植物组织上都有。

shots.scene: 转移室里没有风的箭头，箱外的风箭头被挡住
shots.prompt_en: A transfer chamber with still air inside, while wind arrows outside are blocked by its walls. No people.
shots.narration: 转接要在无菌、无风的箱内进行。

shots.section_title: 灭菌只能尽量降低风险
shots.scene: 一个目标靶，靶心是被消灭的细菌图标
shots.prompt_en: A target icon with a crossed-out bacterium in the bullseye. No people.
shots.narration: 灭菌，是要消灭所有微生物，
overlay: 灭菌只能尽量降低风险

shots.section_title: 灭菌只能尽量降低风险
shots.scene: 风险刻度从高往低移动，但不到零
shots.prompt_en: A risk gauge with the needle moving from high to low but not reaching zero. No people.
shots.narration: 可这很难做到，只能尽量降低风险。

shots.section_title: 活组织不能高温高压，靠酒精消毒
shots.scene: 高压灭菌锅图标，旁边一棵小苗被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an autoclave next to a small plantlet crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 高温高压最彻底，但会杀死活组织。
overlay: 活组织不能高温高压，靠酒精消毒

shots.section_title: 活组织不能高温高压，靠酒精消毒
shots.scene: 空白喷壶和酒精瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank spray bottle and a blank alcohol bottle with a flame pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 所以组培主要靠酒精类消毒剂。

shots.section_title: 活组织不能高温高压，靠酒精消毒
shots.scene: 欣欣在整洁的实验台前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of a tidy, clean lab bench.
shots.narration: 保持清洁，是一切的基础。

shots.scene: 小研用消毒剂擦拭台面，地上放着扫把
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat wipes the bench with disinfectant, a broom leaning nearby.
shots.narration: 开工前，先擦洗台面、清扫地面。

shots.scene: 开着的门窗和通风口吹出风箭头，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an open door, an open window and an air vent blowing wind arrows, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 关好门窗，避开通风口的气流。

shots.scene: 植物组织在水盆里用肥皂水清洗的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a piece of plant tissue being rinsed in a basin with soap bubbles. No people.
shots.narration: 植物材料，先用肥皂和清水洗净。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套向转移室内壁喷洒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing gloves sprays the inner walls of a transfer chamber with a blank spray bottle.
shots.narration: 箱内表面和手套，都喷一遍酒精。

shots.scene: 器械、培养皿、小瓶整齐摆在转移室里
shots.prompt_en: Forceps, a scalpel with a covered blade, petri dishes and small jars neatly arranged inside a transfer chamber. No people.
shots.narration: 消毒前，把要用的东西一次放齐。

shots.scene: 镊子夹着组织块放在无菌培养皿里
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands with forceps place a small piece of plant tissue inside an open sterile petri dish inside the chamber.
shots.narration: 组织放在无菌培养皿里处理，不碰台面。

shots.scene: 阿杰把长发扎起
shots.prompt_en: The young male student ties back his long hair.
shots.narration: 扎起长发，

shots.scene: 阿杰在水池边洗手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student washes his hands with soap at a sink.
shots.narration: 认真洗手，

shots.scene: 阿杰戴上长袖口手套，盖住前臂
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on long-cuff gloves that cover his hands and forearms.
shots.narration: 戴上能盖住前臂的手套。

shots.scene: 头发、皮肤、口鼻三个图标上带小细菌
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with tiny bacteria on them: hair, skin, and a nose and mouth. No people.
shots.narration: 头发、皮肤和口鼻，都带着微生物。

shots.scene: 小研双手缓慢伸进转移室，旁边是慢速图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slowly moves her gloved hands inside a transfer chamber, next to a turtle icon.
shots.narration: 箱内箱外，动作都要慢而稳。

shots.scene: 一只手拿着东西从打开的培养基上方经过，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand passing an object over an open dish of culture medium, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别让东西从敞开的培养基上方经过。

shots.scene: 拥挤杂乱的转移室图标被打叉，旁边是整齐的打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a cluttered transfer chamber crossed out with a red X, and a tidy one with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 箱里只放需要的东西。

shots.scene: 一张说话的嘴图标，旁边是安静手势
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a talking mouth with sound waves, next to a finger-on-lips quiet icon. No people.
shots.narration: 操作时少说话。

shots.scene: 两组学生排队等着用同一个转移室
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student wait their turn beside one shared transfer chamber.
shots.narration: 多组共用转移室，人人守规矩。

shots.scene: 阿杰把自己的培养皿从箱里拿出
shots.prompt_en: The young male student removes his petri dishes from the transfer chamber when he is finished.
shots.narration: 用完，把自己的培养皿带走。

shots.scene: 镊子和刀柄浸在盛有消毒液的空白容器里
shots.prompt_en: Forceps and a scalpel handle soaking in a blank container of disinfectant liquid inside the chamber. No people.
shots.narration: 暂时不用的器械，泡在消毒液里。

shots.scene: 小研伸手入箱前先给手套喷消毒剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sprays her gloves with a blank spray bottle before inserting her arms into the chamber.
shots.narration: 再进箱，先给手套消毒，

shots.scene: 轻喷台面的手部特写
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a gloved hand lightly spraying the work surface inside the chamber.
shots.narration: 台面也要再轻喷一遍。

shots.scene: 一排培养皿和日历图标
shots.prompt_en: A row of petri dishes on a shelf next to a calendar icon. No people.
shots.narration: 培养期间，要定期检查培养皿。

shots.scene: 两个培养皿：一个有黏滑菌斑，一个有绒毛状菌丝
shots.prompt_en: Two petri dishes: one with shiny slimy patches, one with fuzzy cotton-like growth. No people.
shots.narration: 黏滑的多是细菌，绒毛状的多是真菌。

shots.scene: 一排培养皿里一个变成灰色，波及旁边
shots.prompt_en: A row of petri dishes where one turns gray and the gray spreads toward its neighbors. No people.
shots.narration: 杂菌可能毁掉整批培养物。

shots.section_title: 发现污染：报告、不开皿、灭菌
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着密封的污染培养皿去找王老师
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries a sealed contaminated petri dish to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 发现污染，立刻报告老师。
overlay: 发现污染：报告、不开皿、灭菌

shots.section_title: 发现污染：报告、不开皿、灭菌
shots.scene: 培养皿盖子用胶带封住，旁边打叉的开盖图标
shots.prompt_en: A petri dish with its lid taped shut, next to a lid-opening icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不开盖，不闻，不看里面。

shots.section_title: 发现污染：报告、不开皿、灭菌
shots.scene: 污染培养皿从生长架上取下，放进灭菌袋
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands remove a contaminated petri dish from a growth shelf and place it into a blank autoclave bag.
shots.narration: 立即从培养室取出，

shots.section_title: 发现污染：报告、不开皿、灭菌
shots.scene: 灭菌袋放进高压灭菌器的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a closed autoclave bag going into an autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 高压灭菌，杀灭杂菌。

shots.section_title: 超净台不等于生物安全柜
shots.scene: 两个设备图标：超净台气流吹向人，生物安全柜气流向内
shots.prompt_en: Two cabinet icons side by side: a clean bench with airflow arrows blowing out toward a person silhouette, and a biological safety cabinet with airflow arrows pulled inward. No people.
shots.narration: 超净台保护样品，不保护人。
overlay: 超净台不等于生物安全柜

shots.section_title: 超净台不等于生物安全柜
shots.scene: 小研把可疑培养物放进生物安全柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places a suspicious culture inside a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 可能有害的材料，用生物安全柜。

shots.section_title: 超净台不等于生物安全柜
shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白文件夹讲解
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank folder and explains to students.
shots.narration: 用什么设备，按风险评估和本校规定。

shots.scene: 酒精瓶上的火焰标志放大
shots.prompt_en: A blank alcohol bottle with a large flammable flame pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 酒精和异丙醇，都是易燃液体。

shots.scene: 喷壶对着燃着的酒精灯喷，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a spray bottle spraying toward a lit alcohol lamp, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不在火焰附近喷酒精。

shots.scene: 泡着器械的酒精杯挨着火焰，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cup of alcohol with tools soaking in it placed next to a flame, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 泡器械的酒精，也要远离火焰。

shots.scene: 用灯帽盖灭酒精灯的图标，打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cap being placed over an alcohol lamp flame to put it out, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 酒精灯用灯帽盖灭，不能用嘴吹。

shots.scene: 用一盏燃着的酒精灯去点另一盏，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of one lit alcohol lamp tilted to light another lamp, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不对火，不给燃着的灯添酒精。

shots.scene: 老李在高压灭菌器旁给阿杰讲解
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer explains the autoclave to the young male student beside a closed autoclave.
shots.narration: 高压灭菌器，培训后才能使用。

shots.scene: 戴隔热手套和面屏的小研站在灭菌器前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing heat-resistant gloves, a face shield and a lab coat stands in front of a closed autoclave.
shots.narration: 取物戴隔热手套，防烫防蒸汽。

shots.scene: 压力表指针回到零位，盖子才打开
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a pressure gauge needle back at the zero mark next to an autoclave lid opening. No people.
shots.narration: 压力归零、按规程等待后再开盖。

shots.scene: 拧紧盖子的密封瓶放进灭菌器，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tightly capped bottle going into an autoclave, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 容器不能拧死密封。

shots.scene: 刀柄、刀片、镊子图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a scalpel handle, a blade and forceps. No people.
shots.narration: 切组织要用刀片，小心割伤。

shots.scene: 徒手装刀片的图标被打叉，用镊子装刀片打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: bare fingers fitting a blade crossed out with a red X, and forceps holding the blade with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 装卸刀片用工具，不用手指。

shots.scene: 刀尖朝外递刀的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a scalpel being handed over blade first, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不对着人，不递刀尖。

shots.scene: 用过的刀片投入锐器盒
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands drop a used blade into a yellow sharps container.
shots.narration: 用过的刀片，放进锐器盒。

shots.section_title: 个人防护与实验后洗手
shots.scene: 小研穿实验服、戴护目镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a lab coat, safety goggles and gloves at the bench.
shots.narration: 穿实验服、戴手套，喷洒时护好眼睛。
overlay: 个人防护与实验后洗手

shots.section_title: 个人防护与实验后洗手
shots.scene: 实验室里吃东西喝水的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of eating food and drinking from a cup in a lab, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里不吃不喝。

shots.section_title: 个人防护与实验后洗手
shots.scene: 阿杰摘下手套后洗手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student removes his gloves and washes his hands at the sink.
shots.narration: 离开前摘手套，洗手。

shots.section_title: 培养物和植物材料的处置
shots.scene: 灭菌后的废培养基放进生物废物桶
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands place sterilized waste culture dishes into a biohazard waste bin.
shots.narration: 灭菌后的培养物，按生物废物处理。
overlay: 培养物和植物材料的处置

shots.section_title: 培养物和植物材料的处置
shots.scene: 把培养皿倒进普通垃圾桶被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of petri dishes being dumped into an ordinary trash can, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能直接扔进生活垃圾。

shots.section_title: 培养物和植物材料的处置
shots.scene: 装着小苗的培养瓶装进书包，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a culture jar with a plantlet being put into a backpack, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 组培苗和转基因材料，不得私自带走。

shots.section_title: 培养物和植物材料的处置
shots.scene: 王老师在空白登记表上签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank record form at a desk.
shots.narration: 处理要登记，按本校规定执行。

shots.scene: 培养皿掉在地上碎开的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a petri dish broken on the floor with spilled agar. No people.
shots.narration: 培养皿打碎，别用手直接捡。

shots.scene: 割伤、烫伤、着火三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a cut finger, a burned hand and a small flame on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 割伤、烫伤、酒精起火，都要报告。

shots.scene: 小研用灭火毯盖住台面上的小火苗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calmly covers a small flame on the bench with a fire blanket.
shots.narration: 小火用灭火毯盖灭，火大就撤离。

shots.scene: 阿杰拨打电话，旁边号码图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student makes a phone call, next to icons of the numbers 119 and 120.
shots.narration: 必要时拨打119或120。

shots.scene: 王老师与小研记录事故经过
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the female graduate student fill in a blank incident report together.
shots.narration: 报告负责人，如实记录经过。

shots.scene: 笔记本上三处高亮的空白条
shots.prompt_en: A blank notebook page with three highlighted blank lines. No people.
shots.narration: 看完标出三个要点，

shots.scene: 新旧两个知识图标用箭头连起来
shots.prompt_en: Two icons connected by arrows: an old notebook and a new notebook. No people.
shots.narration: 想想和学过的知识有什么联系。

shots.scene: 阿杰举手向王老师提问
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand to ask the safety administrator a question.
shots.narration: 有疑问，带着问题去问老师。

shots.scene: 整齐的笔记本放在文件夹里
shots.prompt_en: A tidy notebook placed in a blank folder on a shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 笔记整理好，整门课都用得上。

shots.scene: 阿杰和小研站在转移室前准备开始
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, hair tied back and wearing gloves, stands with the female graduate student in front of a transfer chamber, ready to start.
shots.narration: 复习好了，就可以开始组培实验。

shots.scene: 王老师在讲台前讲解实验步骤
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains the lab steps to the class in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 具体步骤，听老师现场安排。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现转移室、喷壶和洗手图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a transfer chamber, a spray bottle and washing hands.
shots.narration: 清洁、消毒、在箱里操作。

shots.scene: 慢动作、少物品、安静三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a turtle, a tidy chamber and a finger-on-lips quiet sign. No people.
shots.narration: 动作慢，东西少，少说话。

shots.scene: 密封的污染培养皿、报告单和灭菌器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a taped petri dish, a blank report form and an autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 污染皿不开，报告，灭菌。

shots.scene: 酒精瓶远离火焰、刀片进锐器盒的打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons with green checks: an alcohol bottle kept away from a flame, and a blade going into a sharps container. No people.
shots.narration: 酒精远离火，刀片进锐器盒。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整洁的转移室旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a tidy transfer chamber with healthy green plantlets in jars.
shots.narration: 无菌护苗，安全护人，下次见！
